newsitem.title: MEXICO: Dead drug baron's surgeon missing - reports.
newsitem.headline: Dead drug baron's surgeon missing - reports.

text.p: The surgeon who operated on Amado Carrillo Fuentes, the Mexican drug baron who died unexpectedly last week, is missing, newspapers reported on Sunday.
Carrillo Fuentes, the subject of a manhunt, died after an extended operation at a hospital in an upscale area of Mexico City that was aimed at changing his appearance.
He is thought to have died either of complications from liposuction or of an overdose of medicine slipped into his intravenous drip.
Newspaper El Universal reported that the Attorney-General's office wanted to begin an investigation, but was unable to contact the medical staff at the hospital.

Carrillo, 42, ran the Juarez Cartel, based in the northern border city of Ciudad Juarez, across the border from El Paso, Texas. Nicknamed "The Lord of the Skies," Carrillo used passenger jets to transport cocaine from South America to Mexico.
El Universal reported there were rumours the surgeon had been assassinated or was being held by other members of Carrillo's cartel to keep him from answering questions from investigators.

Reports also said alleged drug trafficker Eduardo Gonzalez Quirarte paid the bill for Carrillo's surgery and was responsible for transporting the body to a ranch in northwestern Mexico for burial on Friday.
